_comment: DeepSeek via the Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Copy to ~/.claude/statusline.json. Rates are CNY per 1M tokens: [cache-hit, input, output], OFF-PEAK, from the official price sheet (verified 2026-10-30). Peak = 2x, weekdays 09:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00 Beijing time. The `holidays` list is China's 2026 public holidays (国办发明电〔2025〕7号); append each year's notice when it is published, or delete the key to ignore holidays.
